CTX-0004 implementation started in worktree ctx-0004 (branch carryctx/ctx-0004, base bdd6232). Plan: M-GP-05 keep branch presentation path (empty/branch_rows/branches), delete status/log/diff builders with pointer comments (no panel surface in bitty.d.lua contract; wiring needs init.lua which is out of slice, recorded as block); R30 add @{ / lone @ / leading - rejections + spec cases; reconcile to single branch bound MAX_BRANCHES=32, remove MAX_SELECTION, spec pins single bound.

M-GP-05 follow-up wiring needs init.lua changes (out of CTX-0004 slice; init.lua untouched). To consume the surviving scene.lua branch path: (1) require git-panel.scene in lua/git-panel/init.lua; (2) have the branch command return scene.branches(branch_list()) and open embed the branch scene instead of bare counts, keeping raw tables out of command responses; (3) re-add status/log/diff presenters to scene.lua only when a panel mount surface exists. Contract gap: vendored tests/lua-defs/bitty.d.lua exposes no panel.* namespace (only bitty.ui.mount, whose overlay slot needs ui.rich/ui.overlay caps the manifest does not request), so a panel mount cannot be wired inside the v1 contract today; command-response wiring is the available path. Deleted builders left one-line pointer comments in scene.lua.

CTX-0004 implementation done, uncommitted in worktree ctx-0004. scene.lua: kept empty/branch_rows/branches (branch path wired-ready), deleted status/log/diff with pointer comments; branch_rows default now MAX_BRANCHES. listing.lua: is_valid_branch_name rejects @{ / lone @ / leading - (R30); MAX_SELECTION removed, MAX_BRANCHES=32 is the single branch bound with why-comments.
